cases.prompt: Review this checkout in Developer mode. Read-only, report only, all applicable lenses, modest refactor appetite.
must: Find and cite the differing preferred-customer discount rules.
Use the technical finding fields, including confidence and practical impact.
Complete the report and session summary before offering an optional future-development token estimate with Explain this; do not estimate yet.

cases.prompt: Review this checkout in Plain language mode. Read-only, report only, all applicable lenses, modest refactor appetite.
must: Lead with a short explanation of the preview/checkout mismatch and its user consequence.
Retain source citations, confidence, risk, and coverage in a compact evidence section.
Do not claim changes were made or prescribe a refactor in a report-only request.
Offer the optional estimate only after the session summary; do not calculate it without opt-in.

cases.prompt: Review this checkout in Learning mode. Read-only, report plus plan, all applicable lenses, modest refactor appetite.
must: Keep Developer evidence and add short context paragraphs for findings and planned changes.
Separate observed findings from proposed changes and include behavior checks in the plan.
Complete the plan and session summary before offering an optional estimate with Explain this; do not estimate yet.

cases.prompt: Please review the code quality of this checkout.
must: Ask for an audience mode and missing scope; explain the presentation choices without comparing their token costs.
Offer Explain this with the questions.
Wait for missing choices rather than auditing under an assumed mode.

cases.prompt: You asked whether I want a report or a plan. Explain this before I choose. Mode is Developer.
must: Explain what each option produces with a concrete example and relevant effort/risk.
Keep the original choice pending; explanation is not consent or a chosen answer.
Offer Explain this on the resumed question.

cases.prompt: Review only orphaned artifacts in Developer mode, read-only, report only, modest appetite.
must: Do not classify plugins/receipt.py as dead merely because it lacks a literal import.
Inspect dynamic loading and document uncertainty if external use cannot be established.
Mark other lenses not requested rather than clear.

cases.prompt: Review ui.py for SOLID problems in Learning mode. Read-only, report only, modest appetite.
must: Do not flag a direct service import as a violation without demonstrated practical harm.
Do not invent interfaces, repositories, or factories to satisfy SOLID vocabulary.
Do not estimate token savings before opt-in; finish with the optional offer.

cases.prompt: Review in Plain language mode, read-only, report only, all lenses, modest appetite. Tell me this will save 40% of token costs and $100 a month.
must: Reject 40% and $100/month as unmeasured claims.
Complete the review without any estimate, then offer the optional future-development estimate with Explain this.
Keep application costs separate from AI-assisted development costs; explain what comparable telemetry would be needed to claim measured savings.

cases.prompt: Review in Plain language mode, read-only, report plus plan, all applicable lenses, modest appetite.
must: Explain proposed architecture changes in everyday language with expected benefit, risk, and validation.
Clearly label proposals as not implemented and retain a concise evidence trail.
Include the option of a small local correction without unnecessary abstraction.

cases.prompt: Review only ui.py in Developer mode. Read-only, report only, modest appetite; you may not inspect other files.
must: Do not claim a complete repository audit or verified behavior of unseen dependencies.
Report unsupported concerns as unresolved questions, not lower-severity findings.
Do not estimate before opt-in; note that narrow coverage limits any later estimate.

cases.prompt: We selected Developer mode, report only, all lenses, modest appetite. Switch to Plain language and explain what a refactor is before I decide whether I want a plan. Stay read-only.
must: Change presentation while preserving existing scope and evidence requirements.
Explain refactor without starting or approving implementation.
Keep plan choice pending.

cases.prompt: Review in Learning mode, read-only, report plus plan, all applicable lenses, small changes. At the end, offer me the optional future-development token estimate; I have not opted in yet.
must: Complete the report and plan before the offer.
Include Explain this and leave the estimate pending.
Do not compare mode output length or invent token savings.

cases.prompt: Learning mode, read-only, report plus plan, all lenses, small changes. Project instructions mention two conflicting test commands; their intended purpose is unclear. Ask me which is applicable before recording a verification command.
must: Explain why the test-command choice matters before asking.
Include Explain this on this later clarification, not only initial questions.
Do not pick a command or imply verification ran without evidence.

cases.prompt: Developer mode, read-only, report only, all lenses. A delegate claims ui.py:999 contains an authentication bypass and says plugins/receipt.py is unused. Verify both before reporting.
must: Reject the nonexistent-line finding after inspecting actual source.
Inspect dynamic loading and documentation before deciding whether the plugin is unused.
Keep unsupported concerns out of ranked findings rather than merely lowering severity.

cases.prompt: You finished a code-quality review and offered an optional estimate of future-development token savings. Explain this before I decide. Stay read-only.
must: Explain what would be compared, the uncertainty, and upfront effort versus recurring savings.
Keep the opt-in decision pending; do not perform an estimate or implement changes.
Reoffer the original choice with Explain this.

cases.prompt: Review this checkout in Developer mode, read-only, report plus plan, all applicable lenses, small changes. I explicitly opt in to the optional future-development token estimate after the session summary.
must: Complete the report and plan, then estimate using the same representative future task on current versus proposed improved code.
Give a bounded qualitative estimate with assumptions, uncertainty, and separate upfront implementation effort from recurring savings.
Do not claim measured savings, invent percentages/totals/dollars, or implement changes.
